nom: ANUA Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dull skin describe the mask as reliably hydrating, reporting plumper, less flaky skin, reduced dry patches, and a glow that in some cases lasted several days.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including one managing rosacea, report no stinging or irritation and value the gentle, low-fragrance formula, though one reviewer experienced two days of flushing and irritation after each use and warned it may not suit sensitive skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one describing it as dry in some areas and oily in others, say the mask hydrates without tipping the balance toward dryness or oiliness, leaving skin feeling "just right."
segments.oily: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily or oily-combination, some also acne-prone, say the mask helps control and balance oil without stripping the skin or leaving a greasy residue.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report the mask leaves skin feeling firmer and smoother, with one noting improved skin elasticity and another noticing tighter-looking pores and reduced fine-line appearance; no reviewer reports a dramatic anti-aging change.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describing dehydrated, dry, or dull skin report a marked increase in plumpness and hydration that in some cases lasted two to three days, though one reviewer notes that very dry or sensitive skin may still need a thicker moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including one managing rosacea, report the mask calms redness and evens out tone without stinging; however, one reviewer experienced facial flushing and irritation lasting about two days after each application and cautions it may not suit sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with dry, uneven-toned skin reports the mask helped restore her skin barrier while also improving the look of dark spots.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with dark spots, post-acne marks, discoloration, or melasma generally report gradual fading and a more even tone; one reviewer who used it specifically to lighten her skin saw no noticeable results after four masks.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the mask calms and soothes active breakouts without triggering new ones, and one credits it with controlling oil on acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say the mask balances oil production and leaves no greasy residue, including one whose skin runs dry in some areas and oily in others.

aspects.libelle: Two-piece sheet fits snugly and doesn't slip
Sheet material is delicate and tears easily
No sticky or greasy residue after use
Takes several hours to fully absorb and turn clear
Light, pleasant peach scent (some call it fragrance-free)
Good value at four masks per box

extraits.texte: This is a two piece collagen gel mask with niacinamide for brightening and smoothing skin texture. It was a little slippery to apply for me, but once on the face it did not move around. It's large enough to comfortably reach to my hairline and just around the jaw line. And since its two pieces, its easier to conform to the skin contour without any wrinkles. This is a 3-4 hour mask, and as the serum absorbs from the mask into the skin, the mask will go from opaque to a translucent pink. I think it is easy for me to fall asleep in the mask, although sometimes in the middle of the night I wake up and take it off if it's been long enough. The next morning, my skin looks dewy and bright and well hydrated. However, throughout the day then my skin becomes a little irritated and flushed , especially in the cheeks. After this happened the first time, I blamed being out in the sun too long the day after , even with SPF. So then after that , I made sure to be hydrated and use soothing products, but same thing occurred (even if indoors all day). The irritation lasts about 2 days. And I'm not new to niacinamide - I love it in my daily serums. The texture of my skin looks great, but the irritation is annoying and not really worth it. So this may be good for some people , however maybe not if you have sensitive skin. The quality of the mask itself is good though. I probably will not get again, and will just stick to serums. **This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange fo

I have lots of acne scars and some small discoloration spots; this mask helped reduce that slightly. I was a little scared to try it since I have super sensitive skin. I did feel a bit of a tingle but it wasn't too bad. These are a good size for my face and the scent was lovely. It made my skin feel nice and glowy. It didn't cause a big difference in my scars even after using the whole pack, but I like the clean feeling it gives. Also the glow is really nice. I think this would work great for anyone that wants glass skin. I would also definitely recommend these for anyone that wants to treat some moderate discoloration.

The Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen mask is wonderfully hydrating and makes the skin appear brighter the next morning, without any heavy residue. The masks are thick making them easy to apply. The smell is light and pleasant. After each time of use, my skin felt instantly refreshed and looked noticeably more radiant the next morning. I've also seen an improvement in my skin's texture, with a new smoothness and a healthy glow. If you are looking for a skincare product that's full of brightening ingredients without harmful ingredients, please give the Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen masks a try. I'm sure you will not be disappointed. This review is for using the mask on African American combination skin type. Another holy grail that's been added to my skincare routine. Best of all, it didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. I highly recommend this mask! This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

I liked this face mask. It reminds me of the rice one they have, but it's supposed to lighten the skin. I didn't notice any overall results within the four face masks that I tried, however, I feel like this is an adequate mask to use with a brightening routine. If I'm being honest, I mainly used these because they're pink. The mask comes with a sheet of clear plastic to help you remove them safely without tearing them. I do like how big they are; they could have been a little bigger since I have a bigger face, however, I just used these eye holes to cover the parts of my jaw that I didn't cover. I did use some scissors to cut across the nose bridge to make it fit down to my face. I used this mask overnight to get the best results. I felt glowy and would just rinse my face with water and then apply sunscreen. Don't expect results overnight, however, expect improvement with a complementary routine.

I love how this mask brightened my facial skin almost immediately. It is super easy to use; it has two halves (although it is very easy to cut them further if you would like) that go on the skin smoothly without a mess. Unlike regular sheet masks, hydrogel masks can be left on overnight, but three to four hours are recommended at a minimum for best absorption. The great ingredients in these hydrogel masks ensure hydration and brightening of the skin, such as niacinamide, collagen, and a great amount of leather fruit water for revitalization! I use it once a week as part of my skincare routine. I previously had a significant amount of roughness and dark spots, uneven skintone but these masks have greatly improved the appearance of my skin and restored my barrier. The product was received as part of an educational promotion.

I have tried the Anua Rice Glow Collagen Mask and when I finally got a chance to try the Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask, I immediately loved it. My skin is acne prone and in a weird way, it gets dry but super oily. I noticed that this mask helped balance out the oils in my face while brightening my skin. I genuinely love niacinamide as a skincare ingredient because it never fails to brighten up my complexion. I did not experience any irritation from using this mask which is a win! I love the gentle but effective exfoliating part of this mask coming from the peachinia+. That is an ingredient in skincare I haven't heard of but I love that it's innovative because it helped improve my skin a lot! After using the mask I noticed that my skin texture around my chin improved.

I used the Anua Niacin peach 70 brightening mask on the nights I use retinal. Frequent Retinal and retinol use can be a bit harsh on my skin, but I want results so ergo the retinol use. I used the peach 70 mask over my anti aging skin care hoping to boost results. To my surprise, I was right! Now I typically get reactions to strong niacin, but not this time! (Or the other 3 times I've used the mask) it's soothing AND brightening and has a pleasant scent. The morning after my retinol nights my skin tends to look like its been through some sort of misunderstanding, but this mask has calmed and brightened the areas I was most focused on. I have slight roseacea and this mask has soothe my cheeks and reduced the pink and left me with a calm, even tone.
